description:
Bind this session to the project open in Summer Engine and read it: project, current and main scene, engine health, project memory and warnings. Call it first in every chat; the scene tree and settings come on request (include). Next: summer_get_scene_tree.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/get-project-context"}

include.description: Heavy blocks to add to the compact default: 'scene_tree' (the open scene's node tree, up to 200 nodes), 'capabilities' (the engine's full op/capability lists), 'settings' (project settings, curated…

settingsPrefix.description: Only return project settings whose key starts with this prefix, e.g. 'audio/' or 'application/config/'. Omit for the curated default set.

settingsPrefixes.description: Several settings groups at once, e.g. ['audio/', 'layer_names/2d_physics/', 'input/ui_']. Merged with settingsPrefix. Omit for the curated default set.

name: summer_get_project_context
title: Read the project context
